summary: Iteration 10, frontend only. Tested the server build /js/toolbar.min.js, which contains the new shiftBackground (factor 1.2 on dark backgrounds, 0.82 on light). Pages tested: / and /test-modal.html, at desktop 1920x1080 and in a 390x844 touch context, with speechSynthesis mocked. Each link was really hovered with the mouse (page.hover) and focused, and the colour was measured against the real composited background during hover. TARGET FIX VERIFIED: with darkblue_orange_brown alone, and with reinforcedContrasts + darkblue_orange_brown, both 'Télécharger le .xpi' and 'Télécharger le .xpi Android' read rgb(25,16,0) on the real hovered background rgb(217,101,0) = 5.21:1 (was 3.33:1). Focus on rgb(255,121,0) gives 7.16. Resting link darkblue gives 5.82 and visited rgb(104,26,26) gives 4.56. Other links in real hover/focus: peach banner 8.15, white background 8.96, dark header/footer orange 9.84. Static minimums: link 5.15, visited 4.56, hover 7.16. On test-modal, #dark-link gives 5.01 / 5.09 / 9.56, and its real hover is 9.56. ivory_black + darkblue_orange_brown, when the theme is applied and the link style is set afterwards: 5.57 / 4.79 / 10.63, OK. black_ivory + lightblue_orange_lightgreen: 4.56 / 4.80 / 8.88, OK. 2 FAILURES FOUND. (1) NEW REGRESSION caused by shiftBackground: black_green + yellow_orange_blue now gives a pointed colour of rgb(25,16,0) on green rgb(0,128,0) = 3.66:1, for ALL 11 links on / and for both links on /test-modal, in real hover and in focus. It was 4.79 in iteration 9. (2) Stale colours when the theme changes AFTER the link style is set, or when both are applied in the same tick. The 'Télécharger le .xpi' CTA has transition-colors 150ms, so its background is read mid-transition and the wrong values persist. On black it gives link rgb(17,45,55) 1.45, visited 1.37 and hover rgb(25,16,0) 1.12. On green it gives 2.53 / 2.48. Visible in the screenshot as dark blue text on black. RESET: noModifications for both gives 0 classes, 0 custom properties and no adaptive style tag. NON-REGRESSIONS: 15 full palette cycles (change mode across 7 modes, validate, settings, edit color-read, exit, back, reload) plus 5 multi-click cycles on 'Read in colors' gave 0 pageerrors, data-values starting with 'noModifications,' and coherent labels. Masks: desktop 500/500 and touch 382/382, pointer-events none, elementFromPoint gives #dialog-ok, #cp is filled by tap, #dialog-ok is tapped once, reset removes the masks. Touch: tap t1 gives 1 utterance, an empty tap stops it, a re-tap gives 2; after the end, an empty tap then a re-tap gives 3. Mobile tooltip reads 'Tap to vocalize, tap an empty area to stop, tap again to activate'; desktop reads 'Click to vocalize, press Esc or right_click to stop.' Vocalization rules all pass: click reads, re-click stops, another text reads, Esc stops, right click stops, Tab focus on a link reads, Enter on the link being read goes to #ancre, the sentence with a link is read in full, link 1st click reads with no navigation and 2nd click activates, accordion 1st click/tap reads and focuses with 0 toggles and the 2nd toggles, button tap gives 0 then 1. The palette opens in 1 click with 0 utterances. Text reinforcement: #aaa becomes #000, #ff9966 becomes rgb(204,68,0) (hue kept), #555 on #222 becomes #fff, #777 on rgba(0,0,0,.85) becomes #fff; backgrounds unchanged; computed colours restored exactly. EXTRA FINDING, read-aloud layout breakage on flex containers (see ui_bugs).

ui_bugs.issue: On mid-tone dark backgrounds the shifted background crosses the dark/light boundary, so the pointed colour is adapted in the wrong direction. Green rgb(0,128,0) is 'dark' (white 5.14 > black 4.08). shiftBackground x1.2 gives rgb(0,154,0), which is 'light' (black 5.82 > white 3.67). reinforceColor therefore darkens orange to rgb(25,16,0), which reaches 4.5 on the shifted background but is only 3.66:1 on the real green. Measured on every link of / and /test-modal with black_green + yellow_orange_blue, in real hover and in focus. It was 4.79 in iteration 9. Fix: adapt the pointed colour so it passes on BOTH the resting and the shifted background. Keep the polarity of the resting background, or clamp the shift so isDarkBackground(shifted) === isDarkBackground(resting). If no colour satisfies both, prefer the resting background.

Links whose own background has a CSS transition (homepage 'Télécharger le .xpi', which uses transition-colors 150ms) are measured mid-transition when a colour theme is applied, so the computed custom properties are stale and never recomputed. Reproduction: setLinkStyle('darkblue_orange_brown'), wait, then setColorsContrasts('ivory_black'). Result: link rgb(17,45,55) 1.45:1, visited rgb(7,44,7) 1.37, hover rgb(25,16,0) 1.12 on black. The same happens when both setters run in the same tick. black_green gives link 2.53 and visited 2.48. Applying the theme first and the link style afterwards is fine (5.57/4.79/10.63). Fix: during measurement, disable transitions temporarily (inject '* { transition: none !important }', read the backgrounds, then remove it). Alternatively re-run refreshAdaptiveLinks on transitionend or after ~300 ms when the theme changes, or use getThemeBackground() when the theme forces the background.
ui_bugs.selector: a[href] with transition on background-color, e.g. the 'Télécharger le .xpi' CTA

ui_bugs.component: ReadAloudService text wrapping inside flex containers
ui_bugs.issue:
word mode: the words of the inline-flex CTA 'Télécharger le .xpi Android' are wrapped in separate cplus-read-aloud-span flex items. The whitespace text nodes between flex items collapse, so the button shows 'Téléchargerle.xpiAndroid'. innerText becomes 'Télécharger
le
.xpi
Android' and the width goes from 251 to 236 px. Seen in Reading+ mode. sentence mode: flex children (header nav links, hero pills) are wrapped inside a cplus-read-aloud-span, so the flex 'gap' between them is lost: nav gap 20px becomes 0 and pill gap 8px becomes 0. The links visibly stick together ('Téléchargement' next to 'GitHub'). Everything is restored on reset. Fix: when the parent is display flex/grid (inline-flex included), put the separating space inside the word span (for example 'word ' or a trailing space inside the span), or wrap all the words in one inline container span. Never wrap existing flex items in a new span.

action_items: HIGH: fix the shiftBackground regression. The pointed colour must pass on the resting background AND on the shifted one, without flipping polarity. black_green: 3.66:1 on every link (was 4.79).

HIGH: adaptive link colours are stale for links with a background transition when the theme changes after the link style (or in the same tick). Disable transitions while measuring, or recompute after the transition. 'Télécharger le .xpi' gives 1.12–1.45:1 on ivory_black.
MEDIUM: read-aloud span wrapping breaks flex layouts: words lose their spaces in inline-flex in word mode, and flex gap is lost in sentence mode.
critical_code_review_comments: getAdaptedPalette: palette[1] (pointed) is checked ONLY against hoverBackground. The resting background is never validated, so :focus (no background change) can also fail. Validate against both backgrounds.

shiftBackground multiplies the channels: pure black (0,0,0) stays black, so dark pages whose hover lightens a black background get no safety margin. Consider mixing towards white or black (bg + (255-bg)*0.2) instead of multiplying.
Iteration 9 notes are still valid: adaptiveLinks holds duplicates (use a Set), and var(--cplus-link-*) has no fallback when adjustColorForBackground returns ''.

Reinforced-contrast restore rewrites the inline style ('color:#aaa' becomes 'color: rgb(170, 170, 170);'). The computed colour is identical, but the original style attribute string is not restored byte-for-byte. Cosmetic: store and restore the original attribute if exact restoration matters.

context_for_next_testing_agent: hover_probe10.js: page.evaluate(probe, indexOfLinkAmong a[href]). It returns the current computed colour against the composited background, plus :hover. Use it after locator.hover() + 450 ms (transitions are 150 ms). linkStyleServiceInstance and the other *ServiceInstance objects are script-scope globals, NOT window properties: use typeof linkStyleServiceInstance in wait_for_function. To reproduce the stale-transition bug, set the link style first, then the theme. Use readingGuideServiceInstance.setReadingMaskGuide('maskGuide') for the masks and readAloudServiceInstance.setReadAloud('sentence'|'word') for read-aloud. The pastille is at about (1865,30) on 1920 width: compute it from the shadowRoot #confort rect, do not use screenshot coordinates. Multi-click target: shadowRoot 'app-color-read app-btn-setting button'.
rca of the issue: (1) The pointed colour is now adapted against the shifted background only. For green (0,128,0), x1.2 gives (0,154,0) and flips isDarkBackground from dark to light, so reinforceColor goes towards black: rgb(25,16,0) is 3.66:1 on the real green. (2) getBlendedBackground reads getComputedStyle during a 150 ms background-color transition triggered by the theme stylesheet, so the intermediate or old colour is cached in paletteCache and in the custom properties, and is never refreshed. (3) The read-aloud wrapper inserts spans as flex items or wraps existing flex items; whitespace between flex items is not rendered and gap applies to the wrapper instead of the original items.
